---
title: "Speed vs HIC for Identical Configurations"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

input_file <- "variable-speed.csv"
data_raw <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Coerce numeric fields
data <- data_raw %>%
  mutate(
    closingSpeed_kph = as.numeric(closingSpeed_kph),
    HIC = as.numeric(HIC),
    HIC_duration = as.numeric(HIC_duration)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hic_bucket = case_when(
      !is.na(HIC_duration) & abs(HIC_duration - 15) <= 1 ~ "15",
      !is.na(HIC_duration) & abs(HIC_duration - 36) <= 1 ~ "36",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(closingSpeed_kph),
    !is.na(HIC),
    !is.na(hic_bucket),
    closingSpeed_kph <= 60  # exclude high-speed outliers (>60 kph)
  )

glimpse(data)
```

The input (`variable-speed.csv`) is assumed to already satisfy:

- Configuration: vehicle into barrier, 0 deg impact, 0 mm offset
- Occupant location, type, sex, and dummy percentile consistent within each make/model/year
- Multiple `testNo` entries per make/model/year/occupant combination

## Overall relationship (descriptive only)

```{r overall-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(data, aes(closingSpeed_kph, HIC)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "HIC vs. Closing Speed (all rows, descriptive LOESS)",
    x = "Closing speed (kph)",
    y = "HIC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Within-vehicle comparisons

Group by make/model/year/occupant characteristics to see how HIC changes with speed when everything else is matched.

```{r by-vehicle}
by_vehicle <- data %>%
  group_by(make, model, year, occupantLocation, occupantType, occupantSex, dummySizePercentile) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(testNo) > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    n_tests = n(),
    speeds = n_distinct(closingSpeed_kph),
    min_speed = min(closingSpeed_kph),
    max_speed = max(closingSpeed_kph),
    min_HIC = min(HIC),
    max_HIC = max(HIC),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(speeds), desc(n_tests))

by_vehicle
```

## Per-group model selection (nonlinear allowed, lower-order terms fixed at 0)

Instead of assuming a single linear form, fit alternative shapes within each tightly matched group (same make/model/year and occupant attributes) and pick the best via AIC. Candidate models:

- Linear through origin: `HIC ~ b * speed` (no intercept)
- Pure quadratic: `HIC ~ b * speed^2` (no intercept or linear term; only if the group has at least 3 distinct speeds)

```{r per-group-model-selection, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
group_cols <- c("make", "model", "year", "occupantLocation", "occupantType", "occupantSex", "dummySizePercentile", "hic_bucket")

best_fits <- data %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
  filter(
    n_distinct(closingSpeed_kph) > 1,
    (max(closingSpeed_kph) - min(closingSpeed_kph)) >= 5  # require at least 5 kph spread
  ) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    n_speeds <- n_distinct(.x$closingSpeed_kph)
    models <- list(
      linear = lm(HIC ~ 0 + closingSpeed_kph, data = .x), # through origin
      cubic = lm(HIC ~ 0 + I(closingSpeed_kph^3), data = .x) # pure cubic
    )
    if (n_speeds >= 3) {
      models$quadratic <- lm(HIC ~ 0 + I(closingSpeed_kph^2), data = .x) # pure quadratic, no intercept/linear term
    }
    aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
    best_name <- names(aics)[which.min(aics)]
    best_model <- models[[best_name]]

    pred_grid <- tibble(closingSpeed_kph = seq(min(.x$closingSpeed_kph), max(.x$closingSpeed_kph), length.out = 50))
    preds <- predict(best_model, newdata = pred_grid, se.fit = TRUE)
    pred_grid <- pred_grid %>%
      mutate(fit = preds$fit, se = preds$se.fit)

    tibble(
      best_model = best_name,
      n_tests = nrow(.x),
      n_speeds = n_speeds,
      aic_linear = unname(aics["linear"]),
      aic_quadratic = if ("quadratic" %in% names(aics)) unname(aics["quadratic"]) else NA_real_,
      aic_cubic = unname(aics["cubic"]),
      data = list(.x),
      preds = list(pred_grid)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(n_speeds), desc(n_tests))

best_fits %>%
  select(all_of(group_cols), best_model, n_tests, n_speeds, aic_linear, aic_quadratic, aic_cubic) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_speeds), desc(n_tests))
```

### Visualize best-fit shapes (first few groups)

```{r best-fit-plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
plot_count <- min(6, nrow(best_fits))
if (plot_count > 0) {
  plots <- best_fits %>%
    mutate(plot = pmap(list(data, preds, make, model, year, occupantLocation, occupantType, occupantSex, dummySizePercentile, best_model), ~{
      df <- ..1
      pr <- ..2
      ggplot(df, aes(closingSpeed_kph, HIC)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        geom_line(data = pr, aes(y = fit), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(..3, " ", ..4, " (", ..5, ") - ", ..6, " - best: ", ..7),
          x = "Closing speed (kph)",
          y = "HIC"
        ) +
        theme_minimal()
    }))

  for (i in seq_len(plot_count)) {
    print(plots$plot[[i]])
  }
} else {
  cat("No groups with multiple speeds to plot.\n")
}
```

### Faceted view of all groups (saved to disk)

```{r best-fit-facets, echo=TRUE, results='markup', fig.show='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
if (nrow(best_fits) > 0) {
  dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

  df_all <- best_fits %>%
    select(all_of(group_cols), data) %>%
    mutate(
      id = row_number(),
      occ_loc_short = abbreviate(occupantLocation, minlength = 6),
      occ_type_short = abbreviate(occupantType, minlength = 6),
      title = paste(make, model, year, occ_loc_short, occ_type_short, occupantSex, dummySizePercentile, sep = " | ")
    )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_all))) {
    row <- df_all[i, ]
    pts <- unnest(row %>% select(data), cols = c(data))

    # Pure cubic fit through origin
    fit <- tryCatch(
      lm(HIC ~ 0 + I(closingSpeed_kph^3), data = pts),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit)) next

    grid <- tibble(closingSpeed_kph = seq(min(pts$closingSpeed_kph), max(pts$closingSpeed_kph), length.out = 50))
    grid$fit <- predict(fit, newdata = grid)

    p <- ggplot(pts, aes(closingSpeed_kph, HIC)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 3) +
      geom_line(data = grid, aes(y = fit), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(row$title),
        subtitle = "Cubic fit: HIC ~ b * speed^3",
        x = "Closing speed (kph)",
        y = "HIC"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11)

    fname <- file.path("plots", sprintf("best-fit-%02d.png", i))
    ggsave(fname, p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  }

  cat("Saved", nrow(df_all), "per-group cubic plots to ./plots/best-fit-XX.png\n")
} else {
  cat("No groups to plot.\n")
}
```

## Global power-law search for a single exponent across all groups

Assume a power-law form `HIC ~ b * speed^n` (no intercept) and find a single exponent `n` that performs best across all matched groups (same make/model/year and occupant attributes). We evaluate candidate `n` values and pick the one minimizing the total AIC across groups that have at least two speeds and a ≥5 kph spread.

```{r power-fit-search}
power_candidates <- seq(0.5, 8, by = 0.1)

power_by_bucket <- function(bucket) {
  subset <- data %>%
    filter(hic_bucket == bucket) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    filter(
      n_distinct(closingSpeed_kph) > 1,
      (max(closingSpeed_kph) - min(closingSpeed_kph)) >= 5
    ) %>%
    group_split()

  power_results <- map_dfr(power_candidates, function(p) {
    aics <- map_dbl(subset, function(df) {
      fit <- lm(HIC ~ 0 + I(closingSpeed_kph ^ p), data = df) # no intercept
      AIC(fit)
    })
    tibble(
      hic_bucket = bucket,
      exponent = p,
      total_aic = sum(aics),
      mean_aic = mean(aics),
      groups = length(aics)
    )
  })

  best_power <- power_results %>% arrange(total_aic) %>% slice(1)
  list(results = power_results, best = best_power)
}

power_15 <- power_by_bucket("15")
power_36 <- power_by_bucket("36")

bind_rows(power_15$best, power_36$best)
```

Inspect how the best single exponent compares to the top alternatives.

```{r power-fit-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
ggplot(power_15$results, aes(exponent, total_aic)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(data = power_15$best, size = 3, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Total AIC vs power exponent (HIC bucket 15±1)",
    x = "Exponent n in speed^n",
    y = "Total AIC (sum over groups)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(power_36$results, aes(exponent, total_aic)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(data = power_36$best, size = 3, color = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Total AIC vs power exponent (HIC bucket 36±1)",
    x = "Exponent n in speed^n",
    y = "Total AIC (sum over groups)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Example fits using the best exponent

```{r power-fit-examples, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
plot_power_examples <- function(best_list, bucket_label) {
  if (nrow(best_list$best) == 0) {
    cat("No groups available for power-law search in bucket", bucket_label, "\n")
    return()
  }
  best_n <- best_list$best$exponent[[1]]
  grouped <- data %>%
    filter(hic_bucket == bucket_label) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) %>%
    filter(
      n_distinct(closingSpeed_kph) > 1,
      (max(closingSpeed_kph) - min(closingSpeed_kph)) >= 5
    ) %>%
    group_split()
  plot_groups <- grouped[seq_len(min(4, length(grouped)))]

  for (df in plot_groups) {
    df <- df %>% arrange(closingSpeed_kph)
    fit <- lm(HIC ~ 0 + I(closingSpeed_kph ^ best_n), data = df) # no intercept
    grid <- tibble(closingSpeed_kph = seq(min(df$closingSpeed_kph), max(df$closingSpeed_kph), length.out = 50))
    grid$fit <- predict(fit, newdata = grid)

    title_txt <- paste0(
      unique(df$make), " ", unique(df$model), " (", unique(df$year), ") - ",
      unique(df$occupantLocation), " | bucket ", bucket_label
    )

    print(
      ggplot(df, aes(closingSpeed_kph, HIC)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
        geom_line(data = grid, aes(y = fit), color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(title_txt, " | power n=", round(best_n, 2)),
          x = "Closing speed (kph)",
          y = "HIC"
        ) +
        theme_minimal()
    )
  }
}

plot_power_examples(power_15, "15")
plot_power_examples(power_36, "36")
```

```{r facet-location, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
ggplot(data, aes(closingSpeed_kph, HIC)) +

  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ occupantLocation) +
  labs(
    title = "HIC vs. speed by occupant location",
    x = "Closing speed (kph)",
    y = "HIC"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Notes

- If no rows appear above, ensure `variable-speed.csv` contains multiple `testNo` entries per make/model/year and consistent occupant attributes.
- Speeds are interpreted numerically; rows with non-numeric speed or HIC are dropped in the cleaning step.
